digest.component_or_area: MCP on-box exposure, auth, and autodeploy
propositions: An ADR must document the decision to run a self-contained rebar MCP HTTP server on the AWS box behind nginx with TLS termination and static bearer-token authentication.
The MCP autodeploy process must follow a blue-green immutable-release model with atomic nginx-upstream pointer swap and retire-when-idle semantics, avoiding the review-bot's saturation gotcha.

MCP-minted op-certs for plan-review and completion-verifier must be signed under the box's existing REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID, not a new environment, to remain enforceable against the single-valued verify.require_environment gate.

The ADR and ADR 0079 amendment must name all concrete config keys (transport, http_tls_at_edge, auth_resource_server_url, static verifier, trusted-env keys) and cross-reference the four relevant prior ADRs and the local main-tracking updater precedent.
